0.description: Fixed an issue where Some Heroic and Normal items had lower stats than their Mythic Counterpart. This requires a cleared cache.
Hearthstone is no longer unique it is now unique 10. This will prevent the issues people run into where they lose their hearthstone in the bank or other places and can't retrieve a new one.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed a bug causing Lunar Aspiration to take you out of metamorphosis.
[Elune] [Area-52] Millhouse Manastorm’s meddling has caused the Dimensional Portal affix to no longer appear in Manastorms.

1.description: [Pending Restart] [Elune] Steed of Glory now increases the duration of Divine Steed by 3 sec, changed from 2. It now also removes existing movement impairing effects when used.

[Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed a bug making Mayhem GCD to underflow and lock every spell cast untill reload (this was caused by Mayhem having short GCD and being affected by Backdraft and Destructive Bargain). Mayhem will now have the same baseline GCD as every other spell = 1.5 second.

2.description: Marks of War gained from combining and refining HR materials have been doubled for Rare and Epic and more than doubled for uncommon combines.

Increased drop chance for Mark of War in TBC HR. Creatures that drop HR materials can also drop Marks of War. Higher Tier creatures have a higher chance, with Heroic Bloodforged creatures having the highest chance.
Added Guard directions in SW and Org for Riding Trainers.
Capital City Riding Trainers can now teach Flying.

[High Risk] Tin, Bronze and Copper Marks of War that drop from creatures in HR have been upgraded to always drop as a Silver or Gold Mark of War. And increased the chance Mark of War drops as a Golden Mark by roughly 700%. More changes will be coming.

5.description: Dice of Destiny are no longer used, but if you happen to get one, they can now be deleted, and will also explain how to reroll starters in the description text.

8.description: Players will no longer be offered the uncompletable Mentor Recruiter quest as this has been deprecated and can now be found in the Path to Ascension UI. If you have this quest, abandon it.

5.description: [Pending restart and cache clear] Fixed an issue where the Hard Khorium Band was displaying as rare instead of epic.
Fixed an issue where [Manastorm Cache: Zul'Aman]  were not opening due to being locked to the wrong event. You can now open them.
